description: Chooses what happens when someone opens a pull request (a review) at one project's code home that no CodeGene task owns, as the project settings' Pull requests row does: adopt makes each new one a task, ignore leaves it a preview only. Only owners and admins can. A choice a decision holds is never changed: the answer is status held with the reason, which you tell the person as it is; do not try again. Answers status saved, unchanged, held, forbidden, invalid or no-code-home.

choice.description: adopt or ignore, as get_review_intake lists them.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: set_review_intake
title: Choose what happens to pull requests
